description: This file defines the SerialNoBatchSelector class used for managing serial number and batch selection dialogs in the ERPNext system, including methods for creating dialogs, validating input, updating item rows, and fetching serial/batch data.

classes.name: SerialNoBatchSelector
classes.description: Class for handling serial number and batch selection dialogs, including creation, validation, and data fetching.

methods.name: get_pending_qty_fields
methods.description: Generates fields related to pending quantity calculations based on BOM and item data.

methods.name: calc_total_selected_qty
methods.description: Calculates total quantity selected across items with the same item code, excluding the current item.

methods.name: check_can_calculate_pending_qty
methods.description: Checks if pending quantity calculation is applicable based on BOM and document data.
